rules.pitcher: At least 20 starts and 100 innings; lowest official ERA, then WHIP, then most outs.
rules.batters: At least 144 PA and positive AB. No injury, handedness or opponent adjustment.
rules.defense: Eight fielders plus DH. A fielding slot needs >=10 starts or >=30 defensive innings at that exact position.
rules.assignment: Maximize sum of shrunken OPS + 0.01*min(PA/600,1) + 0.02*min(position starts/80,1). Player used once.
rules.shrinkage: OBP and SLG each shrunk toward league PA-weighted rate using 200 prior PA.
rules.batting_order: Select #4 by adjusted SLG, #2 by adjusted OPS, #1 by adjusted OBP, #3 by adjusted OPS, #5 by adjusted SLG, #6-9 by adjusted OPS. Remove each chosen hitter before next selection.
rules.scope: A reproducible fantasy lineup, not an actual historical lineup or a proven run-maximizing order.
rules.team_membership: Official season table team labels; not a separately verified end-of-season active roster.
